The snapshot tracks Set Protocol at $10.1M of TVL. Ethereum is the only chain Set Protocol runs on in this snapshot. Cost: about $6 of gas to make the funding transfer. Time: 10 minutes.

Add $140 of liquidity to a main Set Protocol pool on Ethereum and hold the pool position. TVL fell 12.7% this week, so start at about half size (roughly $70) and add the rest only after a week that does not fall. Cost: $140 of capital plus about $6 of gas. Time: 20 minutes to set up.

Once a week, make one swap of about $14 through Set Protocol alongside the pool position, so the wallet shows both providing and trading activity. Cost: about $6 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Once a month, move a tenth of the pool position into a second Set Protocol pool or pair, so the wallet is not tied to a single market. Cost: about $6 of gas for the pair of transactions. Time: 10 minutes a month.

Hold the position for 30 days. The snapshot gives no tracking age for it, so the hold is the standard one. Check once a week that the deposit, shares or receipt are still recorded under the farm wallet, and add one line to a farm log for Set Protocol: the date, the action and the transaction hash. Cost: nothing beyond the $140 staying in place. Time: 5 minutes a week.

Plan netting for Set Protocol: $140 of capital (back on exit, at risk while held), about $145 of gas and about 2.8 hours of work over 5 weeks, against $2.8M of expected value at 58.4% fitted odds: gas runs $0.0522 per $1,000 of expected value. Weekly, check Set Protocol's site, pool pages and announcements for a points, waitlist or token programme; claim only through links the protocol itself publishes, never pay a third party to claim, and if a token launches, start exiting within 7 days. Cost: nothing. Time: 10 minutes a week.
